To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the longitudinal dynamics of entry vehicles into the Earth's (or any other planet's) atmosphere are well approximated by a combination of two simple oscillators, one with very fast and the other with very slow dynamics, and the errors of the approximations are known at all times.
the longitudinal dynamics of an entry vehicle can be described by means of a generalized multiple-scale technique.

the equations of motion describing the longitudinal dynamics of any shuttle vehicle during entry are solved analytically in terms of simply integrable elementary transcendental and algebraic functions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new approach to the dynamics of entry vehicles.
the development of a theory of the dynamics of the space shuttle during entry into the atmosphere of earth.
the development of a theory of dynamics of a space shuttle vehicle during entry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the analytical solutions obtained in this study are accurate enough to be used in the analysis and synthesis of control systems for the shuttle entry problem.
the analytical approach developed here has been shown to be a very powerful tool for predicting the entry dynamics of any vehicle.
the generalized multiple scale technique is a very effective method to study the entry dynamics of the space shuttle.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have obtained a very accurate and general theory of the longitudinal dynamics of entry vehicles.
the approach is a powerful tool for the analysis and design of the dynamics of a shuttle or any other vehicle during entry into a planetary atmosphere.
a very accurate analytical description of the longitudinal dynamics of entry of the shuttle vehicle is obtained by means of the method of multiple scales.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dynamics of the entry trajectory of the shuttle vehicle is very complicated, and the vehicle is very sensitive to small perturbations in the entry trajectory.
the dynamics of the space shuttle can be predicted with high accuracy using our method.
the dynamics of the space shuttle during atmospheric entry are dominated by a slow, time-varying component, which is well approximated by our theory.
